name: open-door
description: Walk the office, spot the risks: an open-source classroom game for interactive learning of threat modelling.

scripts.dev: npm run scenarios && npm run build -w app && concurrently -n room,app -c blue,green "npm run dev -w room" "npm run dev -w app"
scripts.build: npm run scenarios && npm run build -w app
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w room
